w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Gavel is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Focus Group.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lizelle just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Buffering is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w5Mentions.name: The Editor
w5Mentions.firstLine: You turn to leave — behind you, The Editor stirs.
firstContext: 💬 Leo: "Smell that? Something's different here."
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
You turn to leave — behind you, The Editor stirs.
The scissors open — slowly. The film strips show what's about to be cut.
Travel 2 tiles to creek.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Rerun.
firstContext: 💛 You hold Notebook. Route optimizations, glitch lists, apocalypse patch notes. 'DO NOT TRUST THE CACHE BY THE RIVER.' Your magnum opus, half-finished. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they have carried you this far. The feast was the weapon.
Travel 3 tiles to forest floor.
Something moves out there — The Rerun.
👁️ Diana freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
Movement — a deer, white tail raised in alarm.

w5Mentions.name: The Timeslot
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Timeslot.
firstContext: The cistern is dry. Haul from a creek (risky water), or put someone on water duty.

Travel 3 tiles to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Leaf litter, birdcall, the smell of rot becoming soil. The woods, being the woods.
Something moves out there — The Timeslot.
👁️ Diana freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
Sign — a deer, white tail raised in alarm passed here recently. Fresh prints. Close, maybe.

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It sits. Just... sits. Watching. The others are out there too, you can feel them.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)

⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
You camp wild tonight — no hall meal, but the pantry still reaches you through System requisition. Eat from your pack tonight.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A full seat. global standing, every wave faced, the deeds complete. The table rises when you enter. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 6 · Forage 20 · Craft 4 · Talk 15 · Explore 43 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Zoe Adams ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

◈ THE PANTHEON — Ethan Hunt and Diana Osei and Zoe Adams ascended together, and gods, it turns out, have politics. They argue about you the way the living argue about weather. Mostly, they agree: the village comes first. Mostly.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

ghostLines.line: 🚶 A man, maybe 30s is back with Feng.
